- Found (Session A build pass, branch `feat/S1.6-videos`): (1) one boolean cannot tell Oliver's override from the heuristic's last answer, so either every sync overwrites him or the heuristic never re-applies. (2) Writing RSS rows before the Data API is asked gives a live or upcoming stream a public stub that J-D then never removes, and a Data API failure after the RSS upsert breaks T-ACT-45's "no rows changed". (3) The feed is Atom XML; `fetchJson` sends `Accept: application/json` and `JSON.parse`s every 2xx body. (4) `scripts/check-client-islands.mjs` fails any `'use client'` file outside the 03 list, the ISR page may not read `searchParams`, and `UpNextList` only *receives* `selectedId` — no legal component could own `?v=`. (5) A facade `<button>` inside the row `<a>` is invalid HTML and axe `nested-interactive` (serious) — it would fail S1.6.AC10. (6) A type-only import of `@/lib/data/videos` in an island trips INV-09's grep, and that module is `server-only`. (7) 03 O-19 cites DESIGN.md §12.7 but contradicts it on `card`; an 88px block covers about 40% of a 3-up card's height. (8) With one visible long video, AC4's swap, AC5's grid and AC6's "two newest" cannot be shown on seed, and T-E2E-1 / T-E2E-6 are smoke specs that may not mutate. (9) A service-side truncate never revalidates the ISR page, and nothing clicked the dashboard toggle AC7 names. (10) AC11 had no test id. (11) 04 asks for an `is_short` control 02 does not list, the value is tri-state, and the controlled `Toggle` needs a round-trip to re-render. (12) The 1280 prototype (`design/claude-design-export/pass-3/` "Sections") shows head + player + four Up-next rows; how many rows, whether the selected video is listed, and where the grid starts were unspecified. (13) ADR-0039 left Markdown embeds to this slice. (14) INV-58's grep now returns `VideoFacade.tsx` as well. (15) The "until S1.6 …" sentence describes a state this slice ends; YouTube `search` (100 units a call) was never going to be used (00 §S1.6 Risks already says so). **Reconciliation of the docs with the built code (same day):** (16) an upstream that echoes the request URL put `key=<value>` into `AdapterError.body`, and the 300-char cut could leave the head of a key; a feed entry may have no thumbnail and a channel may hide its subscriber count; `oembed` / `videoIdFromUrl` live in the adapter file this slice creates. (17) 04 §3.3 as first rewritten did not say what happens to a known row the API does not return, to a mapped id nobody asked about, to a known row on a no-key run, when `videos` is revalidated, or what AC9's log line is; a no-key run cannot see the live flag. (18) with `upnext` presentational (D5) nothing is left for `onPlay` to intercept; the 03 `VideoStage` row said "views · date" while every other video meta reads "date · views"; the hovered Up-next meta failed contrast. (19) the migration carries CHECK constraints and an index data-model §2.3 does not list, and this ADR's own supabase-reviewer row said "nothing else".
- Related: **names and rewrites 03 §11 O-19** (D7) and **refines 03 §11 O-7** (D5, D4) per ADR-R14; builds the default of 04 §10 OPEN-7 and 00 §5 00-O-5 (D1 and D11 add the storage and the controls those rows leave open — both rows gain a pointer) and of 05 §11 OPEN-19 (D2 is how "live videos excluded" holds under J-D on a keyed run; D18(g) records the no-key limit — the row gains a pointer); **extends ADR-0038 D1** (D11 — the "Saved." wiring list gains `/admin`; ADR-0038 is not edited); follows ADR-0041 D6 (D15) and ADR-0042 D2 (focus never moves on first render — D4); closes ADR-0039's Follow-up "S1.6 decides YouTube embeds in Markdown" (D13). Q30 (`docs/questions.md` — Shorts row) is built as answered, no change. The 04 §5.3 Shorts heuristic is unchanged (no `shorts-detection` ADR). `DESIGN.md` is not edited — D7 follows it, and D19 records how §6.4's "Grid of older videos below on phone" is read. D17–D20 reconcile the amended docs with the built code; they name no `O-` / `OPEN-` / `00-O-` / `Q` row. Supersedes nothing.

## Decision
1. **`videos.is_short_override boolean null` holds Oliver's override; `is_short` stays the effective column.** Every reader keeps filtering on `is_short` (02 §2.1 item 4, RLS tests, `/videos`, Home). `is_short = coalesce(is_short_override, isShort(v))`. `syncYoutube` never writes `is_short_override` (nor `hidden`) and writes `is_short = is_short_override ?? isShort(v)`. `updateVideo`: `is_short: true | false` → `is_short_override` = `is_short` = the value; `is_short: null` → `is_short_override = null` and `is_short` recomputed by `isShort` from the row's stored `duration_seconds` / `title` / `description`. No trigger. The return shape `{youtube_id, hidden, is_short}` is unchanged (the effective value). SEED-11 carries `null` on every row.
2. **`syncYoutube` gathers, then writes.** Order: read existing rows → RSS → (uploads walk when keyed and `full` or the table is empty) → `videos.list` → writes. `listVideos(ids): Promise<MappedVideo[]>` is a plain list; live / upcoming items (`snippet.liveBroadcastContent !== 'none'`) are dropped inside the adapter. A keyed run inserts a new id only when `listVideos` returned it mapped — "not returned" = "not inserted", so a live stream gets no row until it has ended — and leaves a stored row the API did not return untouched. A no-key run inserts RSS-minimal rows (the job builds `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/<id>/hqdefault.jpg` from the id, whatever host the feed names — 01 INV-54); an RSS-only run never downgrades a stored row's Data-API fields. Any list call failing (RSS, `playlistItems`, `videos.list`) = zero rows written + run `ok=false` (J-F; T-ACT-45). `listUploads` has a page cap and a repeated-token guard.
3. **`fetchText` joins `fetchJson` in `lib/adapters/http.ts`; the Atom feed is parsed by hand.** `fetchText(url, opts)` runs the same request loop — 10 s timeout, the SC-09 retry set and backoff, `User-Agent`, key redaction, `AdapterError` — GET only, `Accept` = the caller's `accept` (default `*/*`), resolves to the 2xx body verbatim (empty → `''`), never looks at the response `Content-Type`; the caller owns the parse and its typed `parse_error`. `fetchRss` uses a hand-rolled Atom parser inside `lib/adapters/youtube.ts` (exported as `parseRss(xml)` for its unit tests). No new package (01 INV-78 unchanged; no `Kind: dependency` ADR).
4. **New client island `components/videos/VideoStage.tsx` owns the `?v=` selection.** It reads `?v=` with `useSearchParams` inside a `<Suspense>` whose fallback (`VideoStageView`, same file) renders the same markup for the default selection, so the big player is in the ISR HTML; the page never reads `searchParams`. Props `{ videos: VideoStageItem[]; className? }`, `VideoStageItem = VideoCardData & { blurb: string | null }` (`VideoCardData` itself unchanged). A `?v=` that is absent, unknown, hidden or a Short falls back to the newest. The hero is `VideoFacade variant="hero"` keyed by id (a swap remounts it idle — never two iframes). Title = 2-line clamp with reserved height, meta one line, blurb = 3-line clamp in a box that always holds three — so a swap the user did not start (a direct `/videos?v=<id>` load resolves after hydration) cannot shift layout. Focus never moves on first render; after a pick it stays on the chosen row. Without JS the row link is a harmless reload of the default (03's "works without JS as a full navigation" is withdrawn).
5. **`VideoFacade variant="upnext"` is presentational.** Visuals only — no `<button>`, no iframe, no `track`, play block `aria-hidden`; the `UpNextList` row `<a href="?v=<id>">` is the one interactive element. `onPlay` is no longer "intercepted" by rows. 04 §5.6: `video_play` is fired by every variant that plays.
6. **`VideoCardData` is declared in the pure, client-safe module `lib/videos.ts`** (no directive, no env, no `server-only`) and re-exported with `export type` from `lib/data/videos.ts`. `lib/videos.ts` also holds `VideoStageItem`, `UP_NEXT_COUNT`, `YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_URL`, `youtubeEmbedUrl`, `youtubeWatchUrl`, `splitVideos`, `latestLongVideos`, `blurbFrom` (registry add-first rule). `lib/data/videos.ts` (server-only) keeps the one cached reader `listVisibleVideos` (key `['data-videos-list']`, tag `videos`, revalidate 600; `hidden=false`, newest first) that serves both `/videos` and Home — one cache entry, one stale-while-revalidate window.
7. **Play-block sizes follow DESIGN.md §12.7: `hero` + `mention` 88px · `upnext` 44px · `short` + `card` 56px — Home cards included.** 03 §11 O-19 is rewritten. S1.6.AC3's "88 px" is the big player. `DESIGN.md` is not edited and its version does not move.
8. **SEED-11 = 7 rows, fixed ids in UUID group `09`; group `08` = sync_runs is recorded in 05 §3.** `seedvid0002` long 480 s hidden (the newest row overall); `seedvid0001` long 600 s (the newest visible long); `seedvid0003` short 45 s; `seedvid0004` 724 s, `seedvid0005` 3723 s, `seedvid0006` 185 s with `description` null, `seedvid0007` 61 s — long, visible, strictly older; every date a fixed literal; `is_short_override` null. With `UP_NEXT_COUNT` = 4: Home 2-up = `0001` + `0004`, Up next = `0001`, `0004`, `0005`, `0006`, MORE VIDEOS = `0007`, ShortsRow = `0003`. `SEED_VIDEOS` entries are `{ id, youtubeId }`.
9. **T-E2E-47 hides through `/admin`; it also proves AC7's dashboard path.** One serial describe in `tests/e2e/admin/projects.spec.ts`: a moderator sees the list with the toggles disabled + `title="Admin only"` and no POST; the admin hides every visible video through the Hidden toggles (each is `updateVideo` → `revalidateTag('videos')`), polls `/videos` and `/` to the empty state, un-hides, polls back. No service deletes, no snapshot, no new test id. The page keys on zero **visible** rows; S1.6.AC8 reads "when there are no visible videos". The literally empty list is the unit arm `splitVideos([])`.
10. **AC11's test id is T-ACT-74 (youtube leg)** — a `T-ACT-74 syncYoutube …` describe in `tests/db/jobs/syncYoutube.test.ts`, delivery leg included; it joins 05 §8 row S1.6 and 00 "Tests required".
11. **The `/admin` videos list: a Hidden and a Short `Toggle` per row, a ghost "Auto" button only on rows that carry an override (sends `is_short: null`), `?saved=saved` PRG → `SavedToast` "Saved."; moderators see the controls disabled with `title="Admin only"`.** This extends ADR-0038 D1's wiring list to `/admin`. The list is read on the request-cookie client (`listAdminVideos`, newest first, at most `ADMIN_VIDEOS_LIMIT` = 200), so a moderator's list is RLS-filtered to visible rows. Columns Video · Published · Status · Hidden · Short; Status is a `StatusPill` `hidden` / `live` only (no `short` pill — the Short state reads off its toggle's ON / OFF word). Only an `ok` result redirects to `/admin?saved=saved`; a refused or failed call lands on bare `/admin` with no toast. The "Auto" button's accessible name starts with "Auto" and carries an sr-only suffix naming the video. The dashboard's `SyncStatus` gains the YouTube row (`DASHBOARD_SYNC_SOURCES` = modrinth, curseforge, youtube — 03 §2.10 already lists S1.6; `/admin/projects` keeps `PROJECT_SYNC_SOURCES`), and `triggerSync` runs `syncYoutube`. No `/admin/videos` (ADR-0002 #20 unchanged).
12. **`/videos` composition:** head (`h1` VIDEOS, subline "Mostly me explaining bad decisions.", secondary "Subscribe on YouTube") → `VideoStage` (hero + title / meta / blurb + "Watch on YouTube" + `UpNextList` of the first `UP_NEXT_COUNT` = 4 long videos, the selected one included) → "MORE VIDEOS" `VideoCard` grid = the remaining long videos, 3 / 2 / 1-up, omitted when none → `ShortsRow` last, omitted when no Shorts. Zero visible videos → the §11.7 empty state + channel link only. Both pages read through D6's one reader; the split is the pure `splitVideos` / `latestLongVideos`.
13. **No YouTube embeds in Markdown.** The editor's YouTube button keeps inserting a plain link; `renderMarkdown()` and its sanitize schema are untouched. Reopened only if Oliver asks (`docs/questions.md`).
14. **01 INV-58's Check cell says what its grep now returns:** Ko-fi only in `KofiPanelSlot`, and YouTube's one frame in `VideoFacade` (INV-57).
15. **Home row as built:** one row of two columns — the videos column (`VideoCard variant="home"` ×2) | "Find me" over the compact `TipPanel`, the panel filling its column — and a single column below 900px (videos, Find me, panel). The column head carries an external "@OdSens on YouTube ↗" link (hand-rolled `<a target="_blank">`, the D19 recipe); "Find me" rows are `PlatformMark` 26 + word + the external glyph, new tab, no counts, read from the footer's exported `FIND_ME`; the row's phone gutter is DESIGN.md §3's 24px. No prototype frame shows this row below 900px — the layout is derived from DESIGN.md §6 / §3. The empty Home (no published projects) keeps the panel's own row and renders no videos / Find me row — 02 §2.1 States now says so; item 4's "0 videos" empty state is the normal Home's. 02 §1.1 `/` Components reads `VideoCard`×2. data-model §5 YouTube row: `search` struck.
16. *(number not used — COV-5 was wired in this PR: `vitest.config.ts` enforces the 05 §6 global floor, 75 lines / 70 branches, on the combined run and `coverage.include` gains `emails/**`; measured 92.7 / 82.2 on 2026-09-18. The config was brought up to the spec — no deviation.)*
17. **Adapter surface as built.** `lib/adapters/http.ts` redacts key-like query params in an upstream error body **before** cutting it to 300 chars (every adapter; the invalid-JSON `parse_error` body too) and exports `redactSecrets` and the type `FetchTextOptions`. `youtube.ts`: `RssVideo.thumbnail_url` is `string | null` (the feed value verbatim, never stored), `ChannelStats.subs` is `number | null` (hidden subscriber count — never a made-up 0), the factory result exposes `hasKey` beside `unitsUsed` (keyed calls without a key throw `unsupported`, no request, no unit), and the value exports beyond 04 §4.3's function list are in `_registry.md`. `videoIdFromUrl` and `oembed` ship now with their tests titled T-ADP-14 / T-ADP-15; both ids **stay required by 05 §8 row S1.8** (row S1.6 notes "built early"), and `scripts/check-test-ids.mjs` passes with and without `S1.6` in `SHIPPED_SLICES`. `oembed` has no test-only base override yet (S1.8 decides).
18. **`syncYoutube` write rules as built (refines D2).** (a) A keyed run writes only mapped videos it asked about (existing ∪ RSS ∪ walk), once each. (b) A known row the API did not return is left byte-identical — `synced_at` included; J-I's `synced_at` touch is for rows the run confirmed unchanged, sent in chunks of ≤ 50 ids. (c) Insert = `upsert` on `youtube_id` with `ignoreDuplicates` (a row that appeared since the first read is never overwritten); a known row is a plain `update`, only when a synced column differs. (d) A no-key run on a known row writes only `title` / `published_at` and the effective `is_short` recomputed from the feed title over the stored duration / description (the D1 formula on every write). (e) `revalidateTag('videos')` only when a row was inserted or changed — none on a no-change run, none when a list call failed (the 04 §3.1 / §3.2 rule, 05 T-ACT-51). (f) `summary` extras = `inserted, updated, rss, walked, full, units, errors[]` (+ `degraded: 'no_key'`); S1.6.AC9's log line is the runner's own `done` / `failed` line with `meta.units` (+ `inserted, updated, errors` count, `degraded`), reported on the failure path too. (g) The feed has no live flag: a no-key run may store an RSS-minimal row for a live / upcoming upload, and later keyed runs leave it untouched (J-D) — Oliver can hide it. (h) The cron route turns the walk on only for the literal `?full=1`.
19. **`/videos` component details as built.** `VideoFacade.onPlay` is a **notification** fired after the click has tracked and started playback — not an intercept (nothing in S1.6 passes it; S1.8 `MentionCard` will). The spoken duration is part of the play button's name ("Play <title>, 12 minutes 4 seconds"); an Up-next row prints it as sr text. Meta reads **relative date · views** on the stage, Up next and cards (03's `VideoCard` order; the prototype draws views first). "Watch on YouTube ↗" opens a new tab (`rel="noopener noreferrer"`, sr "(opens in new tab)") so a playing video is not lost; "Subscribe on YouTube" and the empty-state channel link stay same-tab `Button` / `EmptyState` links. A hovered Up-next row's meta steps from `--mute-dim` to `--mute` (4.09:1 → 6.17:1 on `--slab-raised`; existing tokens). **DESIGN.md §6.4's "Grid of older videos below on phone" is read as: the content under the player — on a phone the Up next list cannot sit "at right", so it and the grid stack below;** the MORE VIDEOS grid renders at every width per 03 §2.6 `VideoCard` ("3-up desktop, 2 tablet, 1 phone") and DESIGN.md §11.5 ("Long-form grid keeps its layout"). 03 §2.6 is the detailed reading; `DESIGN.md` is not edited.
20. **`videos` constraints as built.** CHECK `videos_youtube_id_format` (`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}$` — the `updateVideoInput` pattern; every fixture id a sync inserts is 11 url-safe chars), CHECK ≥ 0 on `duration_seconds` / `view_count` / `like_count`, `title` / `thumbnail_url` / `published_at` not null, index `videos_published_at_idx (published_at desc)`, `created_at` / `updated_at` + the `set_updated_at` trigger. The migration's `drop policy if exists` / `drop trigger if exists` lines are the house idempotency idiom (no destructive drop).
21. **`syncYoutube` guards its update on the override it read (refines D1, D18).** The job reads `is_short_override` at step 1, before the network gather; `updateVideo` may flip it meanwhile. The per-row update therefore filters on `youtube_id` **and** the override as read; when no row matches, the same payload is resent without `is_short`, so the other synced columns land, the admin's `is_short` stands and the next run reconciles. No trigger (04 §1.8). The keyed `thumbnail_url` is stored only when it is an `https://i.ytimg.com/` URL, else the `hqdefault` literal (01 INV-54). Test: T-ACT-53 "an override flipped while the run gathers is kept".
22. **Up next duration chip sits flush.** A 44px block (D7) centred on the 132 × 74 thumb leaves exactly 15px under it, so on `upnext` the chip has no inset, one 11px line + 2px padding (15px tall) and no outline of its own — it never touches the square or the triangle, `h:mm:ss` included. The pass-3 artboard's 4px inset assumed its 32px block. Test: T-E2E-6 asserts the two boxes never intersect on any row.
23. **`CLICK TO LOAD YOUTUBE` shows from 312px, never wraps (rewrites the "≥ 200px" clause of 03 §11 O-19).** The hint is 204px wide at 11px Silkscreen; one row of hint + 8px gap + the widest duration chip (75px) inside two 12px insets needs 311px. Between 200 and 311px the literal rule made the hint wrap over the play block (Home cards at 900–1190px, `/videos` cards at 600–1056px). Below 312px the hint is hidden — the play button's accessible name carries the meaning and the chip row is `aria-hidden`.
24. **Up next selection writes `?v=` with `window.history.replaceState`, not `router.replace({scroll:false})` (refines 03 §2.6 `UpNextList`, 02 RP-02's mechanism for this one island).** Found by T-E2E-6 on the production build: once `/videos` had been regenerated (any `revalidateTag('videos')`), `router.replace(…, {scroll:false})` from a row scrolled a 390px page to the top — the soft navigation refetched the route and the scroll hint was lost. Selection is pure client state mirrored into the URL, so no server round-trip is wanted: Next's App Router syncs native `history.replaceState` into `useSearchParams`, the page never scrolls, focus stays on the row, and a pick costs no request. RP-02's rule (the URL is the state; the ISR page never reads `searchParams`) is unchanged; `/projects` filters keep `router.replace`.
25. **A Short's duration chip sits top-left (refines 03 §2.6 `VideoFacade` "duration chip bottom-right … `short` = `--gold` chip").** Found by `spec-drift-reviewer` in Session B (round 1): the code follows the pass-3 Shorts artboard (`design/claude-design-export/pass-3/odsens Screens - Admin and States.dc.html`, chip at `left:5px; top:5px`), which 03's row never recorded. On a 104px-wide 9:16 tile the centred 56px block (D7) and its 5px shadow leave no clean bottom corner, so on `variant="short"` the gold chip is top-left; every other variant keeps bottom-right. DESIGN.md §11.1's "duration chip bottom-right" describes the 16:9 facade and §11.5 names the Shorts chip's colour, not its position — `DESIGN.md` is not edited and its version does not move.

## Alternatives considered
| Alternative | Why not |
|---|---|
| A `BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE` trigger `new.is_short := coalesce(new.is_short_override, new.is_short)` so the job can upsert blindly (D1) | Hides a rule in the database that two callers must still understand; the job already reads the existing rows for D2. |
| Keep 04's order and delete a stub when it turns out to be live (D2) | J-D: jobs never delete (the grep test fails on the literal). |
| `listVideos` returns `{videos, liveIds}` (D2) | Unnecessary once "unmapped = not inserted". |
| An XML parser package (D3) | A dependency ADR and bundle for one small, fixed-shape feed; INV-78 stays as it is. |
| A raw injected `fetch` inside `youtube.ts` (the `resolveIconUrl` precedent) (D3) | Loses SC-09's timeout / retry on the slice's primary list call — AC11 and T-ACT-45 rely on them. |
| Read `searchParams` in the page (D4) | Makes `/videos` dynamic — 02 RP-02 / RP-03, 01 INV-38. |
| Put the selection inside `UpNextList` (D4) | It cannot swap the hero, title and blurb it does not render. |
| Keep the facade `<button>` inside the row link (D5) | Invalid HTML; axe `nested-interactive` fails S1.6.AC10. |
| Declare `VideoCardData` in `VideoCard.tsx` (D6) | A Server Component file is the wrong home for a type three islands and the data layer share; `lib/videos.ts` also carries the pure helpers the unit tests cover. |
| Keep 88px on cards and edit DESIGN.md §12.7 instead (D7) | DESIGN.md is the visual source of truth and §12.7 "wins"; 88px covers ~40% of a card. If David prefers 88 it is a DESIGN.md change with a version bump, not a build decision. |
| One extra seed row only (D8) | Covers AC4 / AC6 but leaves AC5's grid negative unproven. |
| Truncate `videos` with the service client in e2e (D9) | Never reaches the ISR page without waiting out the window (FLK-4); leaves the db dirty for the next spec. |
| A new T-E2E id for the dashboard path (D9) | The same serial describe already needs the toggles; one recipe, no new id. |
| Ship the Short toggle without "Auto" (D11) | `is_short: null` would be reachable only from tests; Oliver could never hand a row back to the heuristic. |
| Inline facades in Markdown (D13) | A client island inside `renderMarkdown()` output and a sanitize-schema change — its own slice. |
| Truncate the error body first, then redact (D17) | A key cut at char 300 no longer matches the redaction pattern, so its head would survive. |
| Touch `synced_at` on a known row the API did not return (D18) | The run did not confirm that row; "last synced" would claim a check that never happened. |
| A full `upsert` for known rows (D18) | The no-key partial payload lacks NOT NULL columns, and a blind upsert could clobber `hidden` / `is_short_override` on a row that appeared mid-run. |
| Keep `onPlay` as a veto (D19) | With `upnext` presentational nothing needs to veto; S1.8's `MentionCard` needs to *learn* that its facade plays. |
| Edit DESIGN.md §6.4 to say "grid at every width" (D19) | 03 §2.6 and DESIGN.md §11.5 already say it; §6.4's sentence reads as the phone stacking order. A DESIGN.md edit would need a version bump for no visual change. |
| Three columns on Home (D15) | The prototype is two columns with the panel under Find me; three columns at 1280 leave ~200px cards with the chip hidden. |

## Consequences
- Positive: Oliver's Shorts choice survives every sync and can be handed back; a live stream never leaves a stub; a failed list call changes nothing; one HTTP loop still guards every outbound call, with no new package; `/videos` stays ISR with the big player in the HTML and a shareable `?v=`; one interactive element per Up-next row; the seed proves AC4 / AC5 / AC6 without mutating; the empty state is proven through the app's own revalidation.
- Negative: two columns describe one fact (`is_short`, `is_short_override`) and only `updateVideo` / `syncYoutube` may write them; a keyed run stores nothing for an id the Data API does not return; a no-key run has no durations, so it classes nothing as a Short until a keyed run fills them (04 §5.3 null guard); a direct `?v=` load swaps after hydration, and without JS `?v=` does nothing; T-E2E-47 is slower (it hides and restores five rows through the UI); a run without `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` cannot see the live flag, so it may store a public RSS-minimal row for a live / upcoming upload that later keyed runs leave alone (D18 — production runs keyed; Oliver can hide such a row).
- Follow-ups: Shorts play inside the 104px tile — a larger playing tile is a new DESIGN.md rule → `docs/questions.md` (Oliver / David); Home prototype extras (project counts beside Find me, 32px marks, the "@OdSens on YouTube →" head link, the row's bottom rule) → `docs/questions.md`; Session B flips this ADR to Accepted at merge (`keep-docs`); S1.8 decides a test-only base override for the youtube `oembed` call (`test-engineer`); the `CLICK TO LOAD YOUTUBE` chip wrapping against the 56px play block on 200–300px cards is a fix for this PR's verify pass (`design-fidelity`), not a decision.

### Notes — built details judged within the spec's latitude (no deviation; listed so `spec-drift-reviewer` can check them)
- `makeVideo` (tests/helpers/factories.ts) defaults `published_at` to a fixed date older than every SEED-11 row, so a factory row never takes the hero / Home / Up-next slots; `factoryYoutubeId` builds 11-char ids (05 §1.3 factories — no rule on defaults).
- `lib/supabase/types.ts` carries a cosmetic generator diff (newer CLI parenthesises six generic constraints) — committed raw per 01 INV-16.
- `blurbFrom` folds inner whitespace and has no length cap (the UI clamps); `latestLongVideos` sorts a copy defensively; `splitVideos` keeps input order (BINDING contract: "first paragraph, trimmed, null when empty").
- Fixture ids are `fixvid…` / `fixmen…`, never the seed's, and every fixture date is older than SEED-11's oldest row, so an e2e sync never changes Home or the hero (05 F-1 / F-5 / F-7; hand-made, no `.meta.json`).
- `description` is stored `''` (not NULL) on a keyed row with no upstream description; NULL stays the RSS-only marker; `blurbFrom` treats both as no blurb. `thumbnail_url` falls back to the `hqdefault` literal when the Data API sends no thumbnails (the column is NOT NULL).
- The existing-rows read is paged (1,000 per page — `supabase/config.toml` `max_rows`), so "all known ids" (04 §3.3) holds past 1,000 rows.
- `updateVideo` answers `not_found` (not `internal`) when the update matches no row — inside 04 §1.8's error list.
- `lib/actions/videos.schema.ts` exports `YOUTUBE_ID_RE` and the type `UpdateVideoInput`; `lib/actions/videos.ts` the type `UpdateVideoData` (the `settings.ts` precedent) — registry Modules line.
- `CLICK TO LOAD YOUTUBE` and the duration chip share one flex row; the hint's fill is `--ink` and the duration chip's border `--line` per 03 (the prototype uses an rgba and `--line-soft` — no such tokens); chip paddings 4 / 8 via tokens. 03 O-19's width rule is a container query at 312px, not 200 (D23).
- The stage's text block reserves its tallest case as one `min-height` (D4's "reserved height" — one box instead of one per element).
- The Home loading shell gained `min-height: 100svh` (geometry only; 02 §6 "hero slab + 4 `ProjectCardSkeleton`" unchanged).
- The Home row's phone gutter is 24px (DESIGN.md §3) while the older Featured / hero sections use the pass-3 phone frame's 20px — a 4px inset difference below 600px, left for a design pass (`docs/questions.md`).
- Test files without a 05 id of their own (ADR-R9 — test additions; `tests/unit/data-projects.test.ts` precedent): `tests/unit/videos.test.ts`, the `spokenDuration` twin in the T-UNIT-12 file, and `tests/db/data/videos.test.ts` (db-lane contract test of `listVisibleVideos`; titles carry T-E2E-6, the e2e it backs) — recorded in 05 §12.
- S1.6.AC8's gloss "no **visible** videos" is a superset of "the table is empty" — no AC removed, weakened or moved (ADR-R3 not triggered).
